claimBoundary: This decision rejects only the coarse CA-HSG portfolio locator. It makes no approval or rejection claim for any exact descendant standard, benchmark, state addition, course limit, process standard, or Mathematical Practice.
officialSourceBoundary: California Common Core State Standards for Mathematics — Higher Mathematics conceptual categories and nested standards
evidenceGaps: CA-HSG supplies no exact assessable action, conditions, representation, or limits.
Full-intent comparison requires a complete exact descendant beneath the Geometry category or scope.
The bounded lesson evidence cannot establish alignment to an entire high-school conceptual category or portfolio scope.
Challenge and transfer tags were not used to infer transfer or mastery.

replacementReview.boundary: Routing hints only; every exact descendant requires a new source-backed full-intent review.

notes: Reject the tc-triangle-inequality -> CA-HSG edge because CA-HSG identifies the Geometry category or portfolio scope, not an exact assessable CA-CCSSM standard.
